confirmedNote: Rules sheet checked against DGFT, RBI and CBIC up to this date. Edit this file on GitHub when a ruling changes — the app updates for everyone.
keyRules: Export proceeds must be realised within 9 months of shipment (12 months if invoiced/settled in INR) — FEMA (Export & Import of Goods and Services) Regulations 2026, in force from 1 Oct 2026.

FEMA Second Amendment (notified 2 Nov 2026, effective 1 Oct 2026): service exporters are deemed to have filed the EDF when they give the bank payment details — resident individuals (any value), others up to ₹10 lakh per remittance.
RoDTEP continues up to 31 Dec 2026 at unchanged rates.
FTAs in force: UK CETA (15 Jul 2026), Oman CEPA (1 Jun 2026), India–New Zealand FTA (20 Oct 2026, 100% of Indian exports duty-free). EU FTA concluded, not yet in force.
INR-invoiced exports get full FTP benefits (FTP amendment, 20 Aug 2026).
Rice (HSN 1006) export policy condition amended by DGFT Notification 47 dated 9 Nov 2026 — check before contracting.
ftas: 100% of Indian exports duty-free from 1 Jan 2026; CECA upgrade under talks
98.08% of Oman's lines duty-free (99.38% of India's exports by value)
Duty-free on ~99% of India's exports by value
97% of EU lines once in force
100% of Indian exports duty-free; preferential CoO filed electronically (DGFT Trade Notice 34/2026-27)
US reciprocal tariff on most Indian goods cut to 18% (Feb 2026); Nov 2026 reports of a permanent 10% rate on ~70% of exports — verify the current rate for your HS code before quoting
